summary.ja: 電子軌道に仮想質量を与え、直交制約付きの拡張系で核と同時に進める。
summary.en: Assign fictitious inertia to orbitals and propagate an orthonormality-constrained extended system with the nuclei.

references.label: R. Car and M. Parrinello (1985), Unified Approach for Molecular Dynamics and Density-Functional Theory
references.scope: Publisher bibliography/abstract and original equations (3)–(5) and discussion of fictitious electronic motion near the BO surface consulted. The paper’s silicon dynamics have not been numerically reproduced.

assumptions: Classical nuclei and a selected adiabatic electronic ground-state model; no verified MD implementation.
Displayed extended-Lagrangian formulas assume fixed cell and fixed occupations.

Actual coupled normalized electronic angle and nuclear coordinate, short NVE plus one nuclear OU trajectory. No first-principles/long NVE/canonical sampling/production CPMD. BO and mu.04 state comparisons use fixed4096/8192 RK4 companions; mu.01 receives energy checks only. Authored dimensionless model units with M=20 and angular fictitious mass mu=.04/.01; these are not cp.x emass units.
assumptions_ja: 核は古典力学、電子は選択した断熱的基底状態モデル。MDの実装・検証は未実施。
表示する拡張ラグランジアンは固定セル・固定占有を仮定。
無次元の核座標と規格化した1電子角。3固定刻み、2架空質量、1固定seedのOU熱浴です。 自作模型の無次元単位。Q,時間,電子角,温度を固定し、M=20、架空角質量μ=.04/.01。cp.xのemass規約とは別です。
units: Authored dimensionless model units with M=20 and angular fictitious mass mu=.04/.01; these are not cp.x emass units.

boundary_conditions: The fixed case-specific conditions only; no general materials or long-MD validation.
boundary_conditions_ja: 各固定例の条件に限定し、一般物質・長時間MDを検証しません。

next_deliverable.en: Maintain these fixed educational examples; broader extensions require a separately specified need.

limitations.en: Long first-principles NVE, general multi-orbital orthonormality/SCF errors, general electronic/nuclear baths, canonical equilibration, adiabatic/ergodic certification and materials remain unverified.

title.ja: 2準位模型のBO/CP型連成と短い核熱浴
title.en: A two-state BO / CP-type model with a short nuclear thermostat coupling

summary.ja: 電子角と核座標を実際に結合した2準位模型を、短いNVEと核熱浴で比較します。
summary.en: Compare a normalized two-state electronic degree of freedom coupled to a nuclear coordinate, short NVE and one nuclear OU bath.

assumptions.ja: 無次元の核座標と規格化した1電子角。3固定刻み、2架空質量、1固定seedのOU熱浴です。 自作模型の無次元単位。Q,時間,電子角,温度を固定し、M=20、架空角質量μ=.04/.01。cp.xのemass規約とは別です。
assumptions.en: Actual coupled normalized electronic angle and nuclear coordinate, short NVE plus one nuclear OU trajectory. No first-principles/long NVE/canonical sampling/production CPMD. BO and mu.04 state comparisons use fixed4096/8192 RK4 companions; mu.01 receives energy checks only. Authored dimensionless model units with M=20 and angular fictitious mass mu=.04/.01; these are not cp.x emass units.

algorithm.ja: 解析BO力とCP型作用の式をVerlet/BAOABで積分し、核熱と架空電子運動エネルギーを分けます。
algorithm.en: Use analytic BO forces and the declared CP-type action with Verlet/BAOAB; record nuclear heat and fictitious electronic kinetic energy separately.

validation.ja: 解析勾配、4096/8192段の固定RK4感度、拡張エネルギーとOU条件付き分散を照合します。
validation.en: Check energy gradients, fixed4096/8192 RK4 sensitivity, extended energy, OU heat bookkeeping and conditional temperature variance.

limits.ja: 短い自作教育模型です。第一原理・長いNVE・一般CPMD・正準平衡・エルゴード性の成功は主張しません。
limits.en: Long first-principles NVE and general electronic/nuclear thermostat equilibration remain deferred. No material prediction, multi-orbital CPMD or canonical/ergodic sampling certificate.

review.en: Selected emass/orthogonalization and CP context. Its physical mass conventions are not silently assigned to the authored dimensionless angle mass.
